Results.ReviewText:
Extremely disappointed in the overall performance of this grill. I previously owned a Q 1000 for many years, and that grill was fantastic, unfortunately because of some damage I bought the Q 1200 as a replacement. Almost two years of use now, and I find that the performance lacking compared to my old Q 1000. Recently, the grill would not heat up well, barely making 500°, and after adding some steaks the temperature would drop to near 400° which it would never recover from. This of course led to poor searing of the meat, so basically a light brown and warm steak. My previous Q 1000 worked equally as well as my Summit and Genesis at home.

I went through all the troubleshooting steps for low heat and yellow flame. As of now I have replaced the regulator, the hose from the problem tank to regulator, and the burner tube. Additionally, I also tried cooking with the 1lb propane bottle to isolate my large tank from the equation. It now will heat up to 550° and did a great job searing my steak on one side. After turning the steak, the temperature dropped as I opened the lid to quickly flip the steak. At this point I once again noticed the temperature not recovering and now the entire burner tube was all yellow flames. Again, no sear on the second side, and another ruined steak. 
 
I have given up on the Q 1200 and really any Q product at this point. If I could go zero stars I would.
Results.Title: Poor performance
